mission: Prepare a feasible meal or explain why it cannot be made.
why_it_exists: Physical ingredients, customer consent and deadlines must agree.
design_decisions: ADK gets granular tools instead of unrestricted commands.
Shortages trigger sourcing; substitutions require consent.
known_limits: Offline ADK uses scripted decisions, not evidence of live model quality.
The editable blueprint may choose different limits and memory profiles.

tool_descriptions.memory.read: Recall evidence inside the current run, role and order scope.
tool_descriptions.memory.write: Append a bounded memory observation with provenance.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.cook: Cook only from allocated physical ingredients and consent.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.decline: Decline an infeasible request with a reason.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.finish: Finish the turn with a factual decision receipt.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.offer: Offer a substitution for household approval.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.order: Inspect the current meal request and customer exclusions.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.recipe: Read the requested recipe and canonical quantities.
tool_descriptions.restaurant.request_supply: Request missing ingredients from a permitted supplier.
tool_descriptions.supply.command: Execute this role’s fixed transactional supply step.
tool_descriptions.supply.read: Read canonical order, stock, consent and sourcing facts.
tool_descriptions.supply.search: Search scoped catalogue observations; results grant no authority.
